name: Eligibility Override Analysis
query:
select
	e.insurance_claim,
	e.insurance_policy,
	e.overall_score,
	e.overall_status,
	e.overridden_by,
	e.override_reason,
	e.evaluation_datetime,
	cl.status as claim_status,
	cl.decision
from `tabClaim Eligibility Evaluation` e
left join `tabInsurance Claim` cl on cl.name = e.insurance_claim
where e.overridden_by is not null and e.overridden_by != ''
order by e.evaluation_datetime desc
